_meta.description: General Menaion propers (prokeimenon, alleluia, koinonikon) by saint category. Sung at Liturgy on polyeleos+/vigil+ Sundays for the saint of the day, attached as the .secondary on the day's prokeimenon, alleluia, and communionHymn. Wired from server-lib/sources/liturgy-from-orthocal.js — see pickGeneralMenaionPropers(). Source: OCA General Menaion via parish service texts; thee/thy register.
_meta._aliasNote: String values map a saint_type to another category (the General Menaion treats venerable-confessors as venerables, etc.). String aliases resolve transitively in propers.js.
_meta._coverageNote: Initial coverage: monastic (incl. confessors), hierarch, hieromartyr, apostle(s), martyr(s) including monastic-martyr and virgin-martyr, prophet (Forerunner aliased to prophet — OCA classes John the Baptist liturgically as a prophet). Unmercenaries, theotokos, fool, cross, nun deliberately omitted pending source verification; they will fall through to the day's Sunday-cycle propers until added.

monastic._source: OCA General Menaion — Common Service for Venerables; cross-referenced against 2026-0705-tt.docx (Uncovering of Relics of Venerable Sergius of Radonezh).

prokeimenon.refrain: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints.
prokeimenon.verse: What shall I render unto the Lord for all that He hath given me?

verses: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord; in His commandments shall he greatly delight.
His seed shall be mighty upon the earth; the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

communionHymn.text: The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance; he shall not be afraid of evil tidings. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!

hierarch._source: OCA General Menaion — Common Service for Hierarchs.

prokeimenon.refrain: My mouth shall speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
prokeimenon.verse: Hear ye this, all ye nations; give ear, all ye that dwell in the world.

verses: The mouth of the righteous shall meditate wisdom, and his tongue shall speak of judgment.

communionHymn.text: The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance; he shall not be afraid of evil tidings. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!

verses: The mouth of the righteous shall meditate wisdom, and his tongue shall speak of judgment.

martyr._source: OCA General Menaion — Common Service for Martyrs.

prokeimenon.refrain: The righteous shall rejoice in the Lord, and shall hope in Him.
prokeimenon.verse: Hear my voice, O God, when I make supplication unto Thee.

verses: The righteous cried, and the Lord heard them, and delivered them out of all their tribulations.

communionHymn.text: Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous; praise is meet for the upright. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!

apostle._source: OCA General Menaion — Common Service for Apostles. Prokeimenon Tone 8 Ps. 18:4; koinonikon shares text with the prokeimenon refrain (standard pattern for apostles).

prokeimenon.refrain: Their proclamation has gone out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the universe.
prokeimenon.verse: The heavens declare the glory of God, the firmament showeth forth the work of His hands.

verses: The heavens shall confess Thy wonders, O Lord, and Thy truth in the church of the saints.

communionHymn.text: Their proclamation has gone out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the universe. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!

prophet._source: OCA General Menaion — Common Service for Prophets.

prokeimenon.refrain: Thou, O Lord, shalt keep us and preserve us, from this generation and forever.
prokeimenon.verse: Save me, O Lord, for the holy man hath ceased; for truths are diminished from among the sons of men.

verses: Moses and Aaron among His priests, and Samuel among them that call upon His name.

communionHymn.text: In everlasting remembrance shall the righteous be; he shall not be afraid of evil tidings. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!
